g.text: Prospective confirmation of the development-selected JEPA

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203343

g.text: 100 simulated robots × 60 s · 8 new sites · 3 independently trained members per new family · 128 runs + 8 replays

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #516574

g.text: Every registered reference remains visible; qualification is evaluated separately for each comparison.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Statistics: both one-sided 99.1667% lower bounds must exceed zero; 20,000 whole-site bootstrap draws, six-comparison budget.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Pending commands are misses for the candidate and successes for the reference in the endpoint check. Intervals condition on the three frozen members.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Integrity/causality/replay gate: PASS. Actual runtime overrun: YES. Engineering covers worst-decile command loss, maximum silence, original video and bulk delivery.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Shared procedural warehouse CAD, stationary and hidden-drift sites; simulation only. Research gates do not establish physical-car performance, production safety, EMA necessity or SOTA.
